workItems.title: Global Payment Platform
workItems.shortDescription: Scaled payment processing to 1M daily transactions
workItems.detailedStory: Built a distributed payment processing system handling over $500M in daily volume across 47 countries. Achieved 99.99% uptime during peak events with sub-50ms latency.
workItems.explorationContent:
### The Challenge

Legacy monolith couldn't handle Black Friday traffic. Cross-region data consistency requirements. PCI compliance at scale.

### The Solution

When the platform hit scaling limits at 100k transactions, I redesigned the architecture using event sourcing and CQRS patterns. This allowed horizontal scaling across regions while maintaining consistency.

### The Results

Implemented event sourcing for audit trail. Multi-region active-active deployment. Zero-downtime migration strategy.

workItems.title: AI-Powered Analytics Dashboard
workItems.shortDescription: Reduced time-to-insight from hours to seconds
workItems.detailedStory: Created an intelligent analytics platform that automatically surfaces insights from petabytes of data using ML models and natural language queries.
workItems.explorationContent:
### The Challenge

Petabyte-scale data processing. Real-time ML inference at scale. Natural language understanding.

### The Solution

Traditional BI tools required analysts to manually build queries and wait hours for results. I built an AI layer that understands natural language questions and pre-computes likely queries.

### The Results

Distributed ML pipeline with caching. Smart query optimization engine. Progressive result streaming.

workItems.title: Real-time Collaboration Engine
workItems.shortDescription: Enabled 50k concurrent users with zero conflicts
workItems.detailedStory: Architected a conflict-free replicated data type (CRDT) based collaboration system supporting real-time editing across global teams.
workItems.explorationContent:
### The Challenge

Global synchronization latency. Conflict resolution at scale. Offline-first architecture.

### The Solution

Traditional collaboration tools suffered from conflicts and data loss. Using CRDTs, I built a system where every edit is preserved and conflicts are mathematically impossible.

### The Results

CRDT-based conflict-free merging. Edge node deployment strategy. Intelligent sync prioritization.
